description: Auto-approve ONLY the status-board plugin's read-only scripts so viewing the board and running /status-board:start or /status-board:finish isn't interrupted by prompts for commands that change nothing. Delegates to approve_read_only.py, which shlex-parses the command and approves exactly one clean invocation (python3, the python fallback, or an absolute interpreter path; optionally prefixed by STATUS_BOARD_WARN_SECS=<n> / STATUS_BOARD_KILL_SECS=<n>, the watchdog's timers) of: status_board.py (renders the board; any args) and plan_flow.py check ... (reads only — no fetch, no network, no write — and prints the facts and the steps to run). Path matching is on the script's stable suffix status-board/scripts/<name>.py, not the install-/version-specific absolute path. Never approved, so they still prompt: plan_flow.py with no subcommand or any subcommand other than check; every git command, push and README edit the check prints for Claude to carry out; any other environment assignment; any command with shell chaining/redirection/substitution (& | ; < > ` $( or a newline). Consent is granted at plugin install/trust time; delete this file to opt out (the skills still work, you'll just approve each script call).
